description: Profile likelihood of the perturber's light-time-corrected geocentric ecliptic-of-date longitude on 1846-09-23 (Galle). At each longitude every other free parameter (Uranus a, e, ϖ, λ₀; perturber m, [a], e, ϖ; λ₀ solved from the constraint) is re-optimised by multistart LM; dchi2 = chi2 − min over all fits for that dataset.
